title: Delhi Police File FIR Against Abhijeet Dhepak, Who Alleges Police Action Was Pre-Meditated
summary: Abhijeet Dhepak was taken into custody by Delhi police; a complaint was filed against him at the police station. The opposition alleged that the police action was pre-meditated and not in response to any crime. Abhijeet Dhepak is the founder of CJP, a social media influencer. He claimed that he was arrested without any reason and his rights were violated.
summary_points: Abhijeet Dhepak was taken into custody by Delhi police
A complaint was filed against him at the police station
The opposition alleged that the police action was pre-meditated
Abhijeet Dhepak claimed he was arrested without any reason and his rights were violated
